## GuiFlexCtrl

*goes below `GuiControl`; client; needs `torque.gui-layout`*

| Field | Type | Default | Range | What it is for |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `direction` | string | `row` |  | The main axis: `row` (left to right), `column` (top to bottom), `row-reverse` or `column-reverse`. |
| `wrap` | string | `nowrap` |  | `nowrap` (one line), `wrap` (as many lines as the children need) or `wrap-reverse`. |
| `justifyContent` | string | `start` |  | Where the children sit along the main axis when they leave room: `start`, `end`, `center`, `space-between`, `space-around` or `space-evenly`. |
| `alignItems` | string | `stretch` |  | Where the children sit across their line: `stretch` (they fill it), `start`, `end`, `center` or `baseline`. |
| `alignContent` | string | `start` |  | How the lines of a wrapped container share its cross axis: the words of `justifyContent`, or `stretch`. |
| `gap` | string | `0` |  | The room between the children: one length, or the room between rows then between columns (`"8 16"`). |
| `padding` | string | `0` |  | The room inside the edges: one to four lengths, CSS's order (top, right, bottom, left). |

## GuiGraphCtrl

## GuiGridCtrl

*goes below `GuiControl`; client; needs `torque.gui-layout`*

| Field | Type | Default | Range | What it is for |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `columns` | string |  |  | The column tracks, left to right: lengths (`120`), percentages (`25%`), shares of the room left (`1fr`), `auto`, `min-content`, `max-content`, `minmax(80, 1fr)`, `fit-content(200)` and `repeat(3, 1fr)` (or `repeat(auto-fill, 96)`). |
| `rows` | string |  |  | The row tracks, top to bottom, in the words of `columns`. |
| `autoColumns` | string | `auto` |  | The size of a column the template does not name (one the auto-flow or a child's `gridColumn` makes). |
| `autoRows` | string | `auto` |  | The size of a row the template does not name. |
| `autoFlow` | string | `row` |  | How children without a place fill the grid: `row` (along the rows), `column`, `row dense` or `column dense`. |
| `justifyItems` | string | `stretch` |  | Where the children sit across their cell's width: `stretch` (they fill it), `start`, `end` or `center`. |
| `alignItems` | string | `stretch` |  | Where the children sit across their cell's height: `stretch`, `start`, `end`, `center` or `baseline`. |
| `justifyContent` | string | `start` |  | Where the columns sit when they leave room: `start`, `end`, `center`, `stretch`, `space-between`, `space-around` or `space-evenly`. |
| `alignContent` | string | `start` |  | Where the rows sit when they leave room, in the words of `justifyContent`. |
| `gap` | string | `0` |  | The room between the cells: one length, or the room between rows then between columns (`"8 16"`). |
| `padding` | string | `0` |  | The room inside the edges: one to four lengths, CSS's order (top, right, bottom, left). |

## PropData

*goes below `GameBaseData`; server and client; needs `torque.props`*

| Field | Type | Default | Range | What it is for |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `shapeFile` | filename |  |  | The shape the prop is drawn as (a `.dts`, or a format the engine imports); empty draws nothing. Collision is `size` or `radius`, not the shape. |
| `drawScale` | Point3F | `1 1 1` |  | The scale the shape is drawn at along each axis (0.001 to 256). |
| `size` | Point3F | `1 1 1` |  | The collision box's full size along each axis, centered on the prop's origin (each 0.02 to 128 units). |
| `radius` | float | `0` | 0 to 64 | Above 0: the prop collides as a ball of this radius (0.01 to 64) and `size` is not used. |
| `mass` | float | `0` | 0 to 100000 | The mass; 0 (the default) takes it from `density` and the volume. |
| `density` | float | `1` | 0.001 to 100000 | Mass a cubic unit, when `mass` is 0. |
| `friction` | float | `0.6` | 0 to 10 | 0 (ice) to 10. |
| `restitution` | float | `0.1` | 0 to 1 | How much a hit bounces back, 0 to 1. |
| `linearDamping` | float | `0.1` | 0 to 100 | How fast it loses speed and spin (roughly a fraction a second), 0 to 100. |
| `angularDamping` | float | `0.3` | 0 to 100 |  |
| `maxSpeed` | float | `100` | 0 to 500 | The fastest it may move, units a second (at most the world's 500). |
| `sleepLinear` | float | `0.1` | 0 to 10 | It falls asleep after half a second slower than these (units and radians a second); 0 for either never sleeps. |
| `sleepAngular` | float | `0.2` | 0 to 10 |  |
| `canFreeze` | bool | `1` |  | Whether `propFreeze` may pin it in place. |
| `maxPerPlayer` | int | `0` | 0 to 1024 | The most props of this kind one player may own (0: only the server's per-player cap). |

| `lengthReel` | float | `0` |  |  |
| `lengthAt` | int | `0` |  |  |
| `lookColor` | string |  |  | The rope's own look: `"r g b a"` (empty: the datablock's), a file (empty: the datablock's), a number (empty: the datablock's) and 1 or 0 (-1: the datablock's). |
| `lookTexture` | string |  |  |  |
| `lookScroll` | string |  |  |  |
| `lookEmissive` | int | `-1` |  |  |
| `curveMode` | int | `0` |  | 1 when the rope has a driven curve, and how its ends leave. |
| `curveStart` | string |  |  |  |
| `curveEnd` | string |  |  |  |
| `curveBend` | float | `0` |  |  |
| `lifeEnd` | int | `0` |  | The server time the rope ends (0: it lasts), and the seconds it fades over before. |
| `lifeFade` | float | `0` |  |  |
| `lifeEvent` | int | `0` |  | The scheduled call that deletes the rope at its end (0: none): a new lifetime takes the place of it. |

## RopeData

*goes below `SimDataBlock`; server and client; needs `torque.rope`*

| Field | Type | Default | Range | What it is for |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `segments` | int | `12` | 2 to 64 | The pieces the rope is cut into. More is smoother and dearer to simulate and draw. |
| `length` | float | `0` | 0 to 10000 | The rope's resting length in world units; 0 is 1.1 times the distance between its ends when it is made. |
| `style` | string | `tube` |  | How the rope is drawn: `"tube"` (lit, casts a shadow), `"ribbon"` (a flat strip that faces the camera along a smooth curve) or `"line"` (a straight strip between the ends, not simulated). Anything else is a warning and a tube. |
| `thickness` | float | `0.06` | 0.005 to 2 | The tube's or strip's width in world units. |
| `stiffness` | float | `0` | 0 to 1 | How much the rope resists bending, 0 (a cord) to 1 (a cable). |
| `damping` | float | `0.5` | 0 to 20 | How fast it loses speed, per second. |
| `gravity` | float | `9.81` | 0 to 100 | The pull toward the ground, in units a second squared. |
| `color` | ColorI | `150 110 70 255` |  | The rope's paint, as `"r g b a"` from 0 to 255. A ribbon or a line is see-through by the alpha; a tube is not. |
| `castShadow` | int | `-1` | -1 to 1 | Whether it casts a shadow from the sun: 1 or 0, or -1 (the default) for the style's own: a tube does, a ribbon and a line do not. A ribbon's or a line's shadow is a band of its thickness that faces the sun, so it does not change as the camera moves. |
| `receiveShadow` | int | `-1` | -1 to 1 | Whether the sun's shadows fall on it: 1 or 0, or -1 (the default) for the style's own: a tube and a ribbon do, a line does unless it is emissive (a laser does not darken). |
| `emissive` | bool | `0` |  | Whether a ribbon or a line glows: drawn in its color with no light or shade (a laser). Fog still covers it. |
| `sim` | string | `verlet` |  | How the rope's shape comes about: `"verlet"` (the default: simulated, sagging and swinging) or `"none"`: not simulated, its shape is driven: straight between its ends, or the curve `ropeSetCurve` sets (a beam from a muzzle), both ends and the curve's tangents following what is drawn each frame. |
| `emissiveIntensity` | float | `1` | 0 to 64 | How bright a glowing ribbon or line is: its color is multiplied by this in the HDR frame, so more than 1 is brighter than white and the bloom (where the renderer has it) catches it. |
| `additive` | bool | `0` |  | Whether a ribbon or a line adds its light to what is behind it (an energy beam) instead of covering it by its alpha. |
| `endThickness` | float | `-1` | -1 to 2 | The width at the far end, in world units: `thickness` tapers to it along the rope. -1 (the default) is no taper. |
| `colorEnd` | string |  |  | The color at the far end, `"r g b a"`: the paint blends from `color` to it along the rope. Empty (the default) is no gradient. |
| `texture` | filename |  |  | A picture to draw the rope with (a `.png` or `.jpg`; empty for none): it runs along the rope (u) and around a tube or across a strip (v). The `color` multiplies it (white keeps its own colors). A ribbon or a line blends by its alpha; a tube cuts out what is under half alpha (and casts no shadow there). A file that is missing or does not load warns once and the rope is drawn plain. |
| `textureLength` | float | `0` | 0 to 1000 | How far along the rope one repeat of the texture is, in world units; 0 (the default) is the rope's width, a square tile. |
| `textureScroll` | float | `0` | -1000 to 1000 | How fast the texture runs along the rope, in repeats a second (negative: toward the start): a laser, a conveyor, an energy beam. |
| `textureFilter` | string | `linear` |  | How the texture is filtered: `"linear"` (the default, with mip levels) or `"nearest"` (hard texels, for pixel art). |
